messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service="inference-frontend-prod" (P1) — elevated 5xx rate from EU region. Incident ID PD-82371. Details: spike detected at 2024-09-15T10:33Z, ~18% 5xx across frontends. Auto-attach: logs, tail-scraper, runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

sasha: Ack'd and taking. I'm in channel and opening the incident bridge.

mike: oncall here, standby to take handoff if needed. What does the initial alert show?

sasha: quick snapshot: loadbalancer shows 502/504 from model-proxy pool eu-a, errors look like connection resets to model backend. No obvious infra node OOMs yet. Pulling logs now.

jonah: any customer-facing impact known? we should ping support if it's user visible.

sasha: support pinged — 3 customers reported request timeouts for generation and embeddings; SLAs degrading for heavy batch jobs. No report of data loss.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update — PD-82371 acknowledged by sasha. Escalation policy: will auto-escalate to platform-t2 in 15m if status != resolved.

sasha: running quick mitigation: divert traffic to fallback variant and reduce concurrency on model-proxy. Doing a controlled reroute now via admin API: ```
POST https://console.internal/api/routes/reroute
{
  "service": "inference-frontend",
  "target_variant": "fallback-small-eu",
  "weight": 100
}
```

mike: good call. I'll verify traffic change and watch error rate. Sasha, want to hand off after reroute?

sasha: handing off to mike — reroute applied, waiting 12s for propagation. Pre-change 5xx=18%, after 12s 5xx ~7% and falling. Continuing to tail the model-proxy logs: seeing many "connection reset by peer" coming from goroutine pool when opening backend connections. Likely root cause is increased backend latency causing proxy timeouts.

jonah: if proxy timeouts, can we increase proxy timeouts as temporary band-aid? also cascade impact on KV cache?

sasha: can do short-term: bump proxy timeout from 5s -> 12s for eu cluster, will patch config and restart proxy rolling. Applying now (low-risk).

pagerbot: config change recorded: proxy.timeout eu=12s by sasha at 2024-09-15T10:37Z.

mike: taking ownership — I'll be primary on this incident until cleared. Sasha handing off documented in incident channel. Sasha: please drop any troubleshooting steps still in-flight.

sasha: left a few notes in the bridge: 1) reroute to fallback-small-eu applied, 2) proxy timeout bumped to 12s, 3) investigating backend model-serving GC spikes, pulling heap profiles next. Leaving bridge but available if needed. :white_check_mark: 

mike: confirmed: 5xx rate trending down to baseline (~1.5%). Customer pings are being replied to by support with ETA 20m. Will keep bridge open for monitoring and next steps (investigate model serving memory behavior).

jonah: thanks — can you also capture timeline for postmortem? include hypothesis about model-serving GC + connection churn.

mike: noted. I'll keep incident assigned and tag platform-ml for deeper digs if we see recurrence. If error rate stays low for 30m, we'll close and transition to postmortem.

incident-bot: PD-82371 status update: acknowledged -> assigned to mike. Auto-resolve timer paused.

mike: status update at +12m: error rate stabilized, reroute and timeout patch holding. Running memory profile dump job on model-server nodes (job id dump-82371). Will follow up with findings in 15m.

pagerbot: PD-82371 — escalation not triggered (held).

mike: final (for now) — ran profile, saw increased GC pause times on model-worker-7 causing connection drops. Created ticket INF-4512 to track model-serving GC tuning and autoscaling limits. Leaving incident assigned for postmortem; closing bridge at 2024-09-15T11:05Z.

incident-bot: Incident thread updated. Last action by mike at 2024-09-15T11:06Z.
